Lina M: Hi — quick question about a recent trip: my flight was changed by the airline due to scheduling, they charged a $225 change fee on the confirmation. I booked on my personal card because the company card wouldn't let me add my companion. Do we reimburse that fee?
Sam R: Was the change date because of the company schedule change (meeting moved) or the airline?
Lina M: Airline did the schedule change (flight moved 6 hours earlier), but the team also pushed our meeting earlier the same day so I had to take an earlier flight. It's a mix.
Jen T: Ugh. We had a similar thing last quarter. People Ops usually asks for notes showing who drove the meeting change. Also need itemized charge and the flight itinerary showing the airline schedule change.
Lina M: Got it. I have the airline e-mail showing schedule change and the booking history PDF. I can also forward the calendar invite threads that show we moved the meeting by 3 hours.
Elena (People Ops): Thanks Lina. Policy recap: if the airline initiates a schedule change and you have to move for company business, we reimburse reasonable change fees. If it's purely personal preference, we do not. Since this is mixed, we treat it as business if the meeting change can be documented and the new flight was necessary for the meeting.
Elena (People Ops): For reimbursement, please attach: 1) airline notification showing schedule change, 2) the itemized charge from your card, 3) calendar invite history or Slack thread that demonstrates meeting time change, and 4) the original & updated itineraries. We need all four to approve.
Lina M: Thanks. One more wrinkle — the PNR included my direct report as a separate ticket but on the same booking reference; can the $225 be split across cost centers? They were on a different project.
Sam R: If you paid the whole PNR on your card, Finance prefers a single claim with a split line by passenger/project. But approval from both project managers is needed.
Elena (People Ops): Correct. For split charge: put two line items in the expense with passenger names and cost center codes, attach a short note naming the PMs who approved the split, and cc their approval email in the expense comments. We can only reimburse to the card used; if you want them to pay their share back to you, that's a separate arrangement between you and them (company won't track internal repayments).
Lina M: Got it. Our PM (Sam) approved via DM. Is a DM approval sufficient?
Sam R: I can send a quick email approving the split to confirm for audit.
Expense Bot: Reminder: attach scanned receipts and use the Expense form -> Travel -> Flight change fee. Allowed per-diem unaffected.
Elena (People Ops): One more note on per-diem: if the schedule change caused an extra overnight, submit a separate hotel/meals claim with dates and receipts. Per-diem rules unchanged.
Lina M: Thanks all — I'll compile the docs and submit. Appreciate the quick answers. :thumbsup:
